Thenmozhi vs The State Of Tamilnadu on 30 October, 2024

When the writ petition is taken up for hearing, the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents, on written instructions from Tahsildar, Namakkal in ROC.No.1745/2024/A4, dated 05.09.2024, submitted that the land acquisition notification in the present case is lapsed as early as 31.12.2009 and the respondents are awaiting formal orders from the Government.
The relevant portion of the letter written by the 2nd respondent is extracted below:-

It is informed that even though the entire land acquisition proceedings initiated through the 4(1) notification issued under the Land Acquisition Act vide G.O.Ms.No.466, Revenue Department, dated 05.06.1998 have lapsed on 31.12.2009,
formal orders have to be obtained from the Government in this regard and that as of now, proposals are being prepared to obtain formal orders from the Government https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis for dropping the petitioner's land in S.Nos.326/1 of Siluvampatty Village of Namakkal Taluk and from the acquisition process.
2. The above said statement made by the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents is recorded and the writ petition is disposed of.
